title: Below-elbow or above-elbow cast for conservative treatment of extra-articular distal radius fractures with dorsal displacement: a prospective randomized trial
journal: Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research
design_evidence: a two-arm, parallel-group, prospective randomised trial to compare short cast (SC) and long cast (LC) treatment of distal radial metaphyseal fractures
population: Patients aged 18 years and over with extra-articular fractures of the distal radius and dorsal displacement (type 2R3A2.2 according to the AO classification)
